title: Shared-prompt Cold vs Reuse with per-request cache-hit deltas
provenance: User-supplied terminal output of a 2026-10-29 probe (same 3950-token prompt sent to all three modes, vLLM /metrics read before and after each request). Transcribed from the terminal text, 2 decimal places.

scope.note: One prompt, one pass per mode (1 Cold + 3 Reuse requests), C1 only. Not the 8-scenario benchmark.

aidaptiv.label: aiDAPTIV
aidaptiv.cache_type: External KV cache (aiDAPTIV, SSD-backed by configuration)

lmcache.label: LMCache
lmcache.cache_type: External KV cache (LMCacheConnectorV1, disk cache configured)

aidaptiv_config.nvme_filesystem: XFS on a 5.6 TB NVMe volume
aidaptiv_config.note: DRAM KV offload is 0 GB, so the external KV cache can only be backed by the SSD tier. Device-level SSD I/O was not measured.

repeat_probe.note: An earlier probe with a different prompt gave the same per-request external hits.

caveats: Per-request counter deltas show the external KV cache served 3,936 (aiDAPTIV) and 3,840 (LMCache) of the 3,950 prompt tokens on every Reuse request, with 0 GPU prefix hits.
Baseline reused 3,936 tokens from the GPU prefix cache, which is faster than either external cache, so Baseline stays fastest on repeated prompts.
SSD-backing is inferred from configuration (aiDAPTIV DRAM offload 0 GB); device-level SSD reads were not measured, so SSD I/O remains unverified.
Single prompt and a single pass per mode (3 Reuse requests): treat percentages as indicative.
